name: aio-golang-mastery
description: Write and lint idiomatic Go end-to-end — a 7-tool lint chain (build, vet, golangci-lint, govulncheck, nilaway, deadcode, race) plus reference-grade patterns for concurrency, errors, generics, gRPC, naming/style enforcement (revive 21-rule set, golangci-lint v2 production config), and production hardening.
